test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Identify the sentence with the INCORRECT usage of the adverb.

options.text: The teacher noticed that all students worked laboriously to complete the project on time
The teacher noticed that all students worked strenuous to complete the project on time.
The teacher noticed that all students worked hard to complete the project on time.
The teacher noticed that all students worked meticulously to complete the project on time.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"strenuous"** is an **adjective**, not an adverb. It describes something that requires a lot of effort or energy (e.g., "a strenuous task").
 
• In the sentence, the verb **"worked"** requires an **adverb** to describe how the students worked. Therefore, "strenuous" is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• A grammatically correct usage would be: **"worked strenuously."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Usage:** *"The teacher noticed that all students worked **strenuously**__ to complete the project on time."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "laboriously"** – Correct adverb; means with great effort. (कड़ी मेहनत से)
 
• **Option 3: "hard"** – Correct adverb; irregular form of “hardly.” Means with intensity or diligence. (मेहनत से)
 
• **Option 4: "meticulously"** – Correct adverb; means with great attention to detail. (बारीकी से)
